# Confuse v0.4.0 - Table of Contents

> Configuration parser for libconfuse style config files.

## Pages

- [Confuse](https://confuse.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Confuse](https://confuse.hexdocs.pm/Confuse.md): Parse config files based on the libconfuse format.

- [Confuse.Fwup](https://confuse.hexdocs.pm/Confuse.Fwup.md): Special-purpose functionality for usage of config files by the [fwup](https://github.com/fwup-home/fwup) tool.
- [Confuse.Fwup.Features](https://confuse.hexdocs.pm/Confuse.Fwup.Features.md): Fwup features.
